scripts.build: npm run build -w @invictus/contracts && npm run build -w @invictus/api && npm run build -w @invictus/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @invictus/contracts && npm run test -w @invictus/api
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w @invictus/contracts && npm run build -w @invictus/api && node --test tests/integration/tenant-isolation.spec.mjs tests/integration/authentication.spec.mjs
scripts.auth:bootstrap: npm run build -w @invictus/contracts && npm run build -w @invictus/api && node scripts/bootstrap-admin.mjs
scripts.auth:mail: npm run build -w @invictus/contracts && npm run build -w @invictus/api && node scripts/read-local-recovery.mjs
